description: Replaces the domain's DMARC record (_dmarc TXT) with the value VizTime computed from the current record: the same policy and report addresses, plus VizTime's address in rua= so VizTime receives the daily DMARC aggregate reports.
variableDescription: dmarctags: the DMARC tags after v=DMARC1, computed by VizTime from the domain's current record (same policy and report addresses, plus VizTime's address in rua=), e.g. p=reject; rua=mailto:reports@example.com,mailto:dmarc-reports@viztime.com
